info.description: RFC 9110 HTTP semantics and RFC 8259 JSON. Cookie-authenticated writes require trusted same-origin context. User API bearer writes do not require Origin; cross-site Fetch Metadata is still refused. No CORS access is added. Response models are safe projections; no database entities, token hashes, sealed values or credentials. Only the Bearer nwu_u_ namespace selects user-token authentication (scheme case-insensitive); other Authorization values preserve browser cookie authentication.

x-node-policies.responseHeaders: All node responses including errors use Cache-Control: no-store and X-Node-Version. 401 includes WWW-Authenticate. HEAD suppresses bodies.
x-node-policies.requestContext: Invalid Host/origin/proxy request context can return 400 before authentication. Node Bearer requests do not require browser Origin.
x-node-policies.compatibility: Unknown request fields are ignored. Resource detail now includes safe nginx preview; older nodes without preview require an explicit unavailable UI fallback. No TS business runtime remains in Next.
x-node-policies.http: RFC 9110 method/status/HEAD semantics and RFC 8259 JSON; nginx directives use nginx-specific validation. Resource CRUD enforces JSON media type (415), bounded body (413), validation (400), and busy ownership (503/Retry-After 1). Pair/certificate legacy body readers currently use 400 for oversize and do not enforce media type; this difference is intentional documentation of current code.
x-node-policies.preview: Server/stream detail preview config is rendered from joined referenced upstreams/certificate readiness; never includes certificate PEM or private key material. config/error are nullable and render failure remains a 200 detail response.
x-node-policies.secrets: Only pairing returns a new plaintext gateway token. Certificate DTO is an explicit allowlist; no opaque sealed credentials or database secrets appear in views.
